lip-deploy-nominal.basis: Battery-side source ranges as the pan baseline: drive 0-52 A moving (adverse replay bus total less mechanism and controls) or 0-10 A docked; steer 0-20 A moving, 0-4 A docked; controls 3-6.5 A. Nip 0-30 A at its SPARK MAX current limit while ejecting, 0 A otherwise (self-locking worm). Latch servo 1.5 A stall at the release, 0.2 A idle. Required: eject 9.0 V, the lowest bus the torque-limited worm-drive trials capture at (field-trials.json G2, 9-12 V); other duties 6.0 V; the 9 V project floor governs. Pack: 12.4 V / 25 mOhm and 11.8 V / 27 mOhm nominal, 11.8 V / 32 mOhm weak (experiments/six-wheel/conditioned-match/supply.py).
